status: rejected; production source and artifacts unchanged
hardware_software: Ryzen AI 7 H 350 / RyzenAI-npu6 AIE2P / XRT 2.25.00 / firmware 1.0.0.63 / Linux 7.0.0-38-generic / project-locked MLIR-AIE and Peano; power mode not reverified
profile_scope: Mean last 3 of 4 instrumented BF16 tokens. Host stage time includes scheduling, switching, DMA and arithmetic. Raw profile in reports/runs/head-tuning-2026-10-03.
candidate: Group two consecutive 16x256 BF16 weight tiles per FIFO object; each device call executes the original two GEMV accumulations in order. Packed host weight layout and mathematical contract unchanged. FIFO operations halved.

experiments.name: key_and_value_chunk2_depth2
experiments.result: compile failed: valuew3_cons_buff_1 needs 16384 bytes with no tile space remaining

experiments.name: key_only_chunk2_depth2
experiments.result: compile failed: raw_join3_buff_0 needs 8192 bytes with no tile space remaining

experiments.name: key_and_value_chunk2_depth1
experiments.result: compiled; independent FP64 oracle, shift, replay, immutable inputs and BO guards passed all four A/B/B/A stage runs; max_abs=2.42144e-7

experiments.name: explicit_placement_chunk2_depth2
experiments.result: compile failed with same value buffer capacity failure; memory-tile input fanout did not resolve it

benchmark.order: A/B/B/A serial NPU; 300 measured samples per block plus 4 warmups
benchmark.limits: Isolated ChannelMix including submit/wait; excludes input upload/reset and readback. No full-model run for this rejected slower variant. Results do not prove that all alternative placements or chunk sizes fail.

decision: Reverted candidate kernel and compiler. The feasible single-buffer variant loses more overlap than it saves in FIFO synchronization. Larger double-buffer variants encountered local-memory placement limits; no hardware-saturation claim.

validation.source_restoration: Kernel and compiler byte-identical to baseline commit; production artifacts never overwritten
validation.host_builds: release and test presets passed (no source changes after restoration)

next_direction: Avoid more FIFO-size-only tuning without a data-layout change that frees local storage. Continue batching/precision-specific dataflow and program-switch reductions.
